title: Chinese Oven Roasted Chicken Noodles
description: A simple and delicious dish that combines the flavors of Chinese cuisine with the convenience of the oven. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.notes: any type of noodle will work

instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the chicken.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced chicken on top of the cooked noodles.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
